findings.title: Swollen but weightless work
findings.claim: Exploratorily, sustained effort and produced work can appear enlarged while being internally spoiled by harmful intake and unable to register as weight.
findings.mechanism: The focus supplies labor and crafted output; 18:105 supplies the material swelling image and the weight test. Their contact transfers the image to the works as a bounded analogy of apparent growth without recognized value.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the lost works as something that may look larger through accumulation while its substance is corrupted, so the later absence of weight becomes more precise than simple disappearance.
findings.containment: This is explicitly exploratory and analogical: the material image is transferred to works because 18:105 applies the relevant root to works and ends with weight. It is not the sole lexical meaning of the focus and does not replace the plain lost-effort reading.

epistemic.reason: The HFT marks this as a surprising exploratory outlier and supplies an explicit analogical containment, while the exact focus and 18:105 anchors are present.
